title: Jack Eckerd
excerpt: Editorial research draft about Jack Eckerd (1913-2004), drugstore magnate and founder of Eckerd Youth Alternatives, Florida's first private juvenile justice provider. Most documented harms at Eckerd programs came after his 1998 stroke or his death and are attributed to the organization.

meta.person_role: Founder of Eckerd Youth Alternatives (later Eckerd Kids, Eckerd Connects); founder of the Eckerd drugstore chain

person_notable_work: Opened the door to privatized youth corrections in Florida in 1982
Built a multi-state network of wilderness camps for delinquent youth
